milestones.title: The First Lot
milestones.blurb: A handful of cars, one Eastside parking lot, and a group chat full of high-schoolers who'd rather be wrenching than anywhere else. No name yet — just the kids who showed up.

milestones.title: Naming It
milestones.blurb: PLACEHOLDER — Duke to confirm. Northwest Motor Club becomes a name. First Instagram post. First T-shirt design that never made it past the chat.

milestones.title: Rooftop Era
milestones.blurb: The garage-roof meets become the club's signature backdrop. Wet concrete, evergreen horizon, and 12 cars parked in an arc. The shot we'd still send if someone asked who we are.

milestones.title: Slower Year
milestones.blurb: PLACEHOLDER — Duke to confirm. Smaller meets. Bigger builds. The group chat stays alive even when the parking lots don't.

milestones.title: Drives, Not Just Meets
milestones.blurb: First full-day Cascade run. The club starts chasing roads, not just backdrops. Stevens Pass → Leavenworth → home with the gauges still hot.

milestones.title: Hundreds Deep
milestones.blurb: Late-night sessions outgrow every lot we know. The drone shots start looking less like a meet and more like a movement. Then the calendar gets full of other things.

milestones.title: The Quiet Year
milestones.blurb: PLACEHOLDER — be honest about the gap. Lives changed. The chat slowed. Some of us moved, some of us moved on. The cars stayed in garages.

milestones.title: The Restart
milestones.blurb: Same crew. Same backroads. New chapter. We're picking up where we left off — older now, fewer free weekends, but the same wet asphalt and the same group chat. The club is open again.
